intro: Gunther's Spellbook is a personal arcane tome tied to a mysterious mage dwelling in Tirisfal Glades. Imbued with an enchantment by Bethor Iceshard, the book serves as proof that other practitioners of magic have successfully broken free of the Lich King's control, though the true history between its owner and the Forsaken remains to be unraveled.
